t: DEWALT MaxFit mixed demolition screwdriver set contains an essential collection of professional hand tools for demanding trade tasks on construction sites and in workshops. Featuring a MaxFit tip design, these screwdrivers ensure better contact with fasteners, significantly reducing slippage and stripping. The ergonomic, bi-material handles provide maximum comfort and allow for superior torque application. Each screwdriver boasts an S2 steel bar, ensuring increased durability and bend resistance, making this 8-piece set reliable for heavy-duty use and general fitting work.
b: Contents: Flared (4 x 100, 5.5 x 125, 6 x 175, 6.5 x 150) , PZ2 x 100, PZ2 x 125, PH2 x 100 and PH2 x 125mm.
Black Chrome for Better Rust & Corrosion Resistance
